String.string:
[EN] You feel someone staring at you.
[ES] Sientes que alguien te está observando.

[EN] Activate all the shield activation switches to cancel the debuff!
[ES] ¡Activa todos los interruptores de activación del escudo para cancelar el efecto negativo!

[EN] Gather all party members gather to cancel the debuff!
[ES] ¡Reúnete con todos los miembros del grupo para cancelar el efecto negativo!

[EN] You cannot get out of this place.
[ES] No puedes salir de este lugar.

[EN] You've defeated the Eye of the Watcher!
[ES] ¡Has derrotado al Eye of the Watcher!

[EN] No! My egg!
[ES] ¡No! ¡Mi huevo!

[EN] You must help the Channelworks sentinel defeat Kerkion!
[ES] ¡Debes ayudar al centinela de Channelworks a derrotar a Kerkion!

[EN] The Channelworks overseer and the Channelworks engineer have come to help you!
[ES] ¡El supervisor de Channelworks y el ingeniero de Channelworks han venido a ayudarte!

[EN] Thank you! I have friends coming to help soon.
[ES] ¡Gracias! Pronto vendrán amigos a ayudarme.

[EN] It's just an oversized pigling!
[ES] ¡Es solo un cerdito gigantesco!

[EN] I'll protect you.
[ES] Te protegeré.

[EN] I am undefeated!
[ES] ¡Soy invicto!

[EN] The egg is about to hatch!
[ES] ¡El huevo está a punto de eclosionar!

[EN] The egg has hatched!
[ES] ¡El huevo ha eclosionado!

[EN] When HP drops to 70% or below, the stack will be reset!
[ES] ¡Cuando los HP bajen al 70% o menos, la acumulación se reiniciará!

[EN] Earned "Engineered Regeneration" from the Channelworks engineer.
[ES] Obtuviste "Engineered Regeneration" del ingeniero de Channelworks.

[EN] Brute! You can't keep this up forever!
[ES] ¡Bruto! ¡No podrás seguir así para siempre!

[EN] The Channelworks sentinel is stunned.
[ES] El centinela de Channelworks está aturdido.

[EN] The Channelworks sentinel has regained consciousness.
[ES] El centinela de Channelworks ha recuperado el conocimiento.

[EN] No...what? Treasure...precious treasure is mine...
[ES] No... ¿qué? El tesoro... el precioso tesoro es mío...

[EN] I...what? I have never lost! Never...lost...
[ES] Yo... ¿qué? ¡Jamás he perdido! Jamás... he perdido...

[EN] Refrain from attempting to escape your demise.
[ES] Abstente de intentar escapar de tu fallecimiento.

[EN] Please remain still for swift elimination.
[ES] Por favor, quédate quieto para una rápida eliminación.

[EN] Shandra Manaya was an inspiration to us all.
[ES] Shandra Manaya fue una inspiración para todos nosotros.

[EN] Initializing trap mode.
[ES] Iniciando modo de trampa.

[EN] Failed...to murderate...the infiltrators...
[ES] Falló... al asesinar... a los infiltrados...

[EN] Let me heal you...
[ES] Déjame curarte...

[EN] Let me make you stronger...
[ES] Déjame hacerte más fuerte...

[EN] Channelworks sentinel has died. You can no longer get "Increasing Frenzy".
[ES] El centinela de Channelworks ha muerto. Ya no puedes obtener "Frenesí creciente".

[EN] Channelworks overseer has died. You can no longer get "Overseen Empowerment".
[ES] El supervisor de Channelworks ha muerto. Ya no puedes obtener "Empoderamiento supervisado".

[EN] Channelworks engineer has died. You can no longer get "Engineered Regeneration".
[ES] El ingeniero de Channelworks ha muerto. Ya no puedes obtener "Regeneración ingenieril".

[EN] Kerkion is enraged!
[ES] ¡Kerkion está enfurecido!

[EN] Hehe...now that you've spent all your energy...
[ES] Je, je... ahora que has gastado toda tu energía...

[EN] Received "Complete Empowerment" from channelworks overseer.
[ES] Has recibido "Empoderamiento completo" del supervisor de Channelworks.

[EN] Received "Complete Frenzy" from channelworks sentinel.
[ES] Has recibido "Frenesí completo" del centinela de Channelworks.

[EN] You will receive a boon in 30 seconds.
[ES] Recibirás una bendición en 30 segundos.

[EN] A boon is now active. (1/3)
[ES] Una bendición está activa ahora. (1/3)

[EN] A boon is now active. (2/3)
[ES] Una bendición está activa ahora. (2/3)

[EN] A boon is now active. (3/3)
[ES] Una bendición está activa ahora. (3/3)

[EN] Channelworks Engineer healed you!
[ES] ¡El ingeniero de Channelworks te curó!

[EN] Channelworks Overseer increased your attack!
[ES] ¡El supervisor de Channelworks aumentó tu ataque!

[EN] You must move outside the walls!
[ES] ¡Debes moverte fuera de las murallas!
